notes.title: Update 1.1
notes.content:
Dear beloved Onii-chans,

Thank you for your supports!

For the past week, your cute sisters have been working tirelessly toward improvements to become more enjoyable.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45575888/b0b2211db6c7f80b67362383b5e700cc50e0b157.png[/img]


Here are what changes:

[b]- Additional Content:[/b]
+ Two new sisters: Irina and Kaoru
+ Irina is available for only 100 love and there will be a lot of items in store for her.
+ Add [Cat Paws] item to shop, which can be equipped by most characters

[b]- Game improvement:[/b]
+ Add setting to change between monitor 1 and 2.
+ Add setting to change dialogue box size. Also, dialogue box size now scale with character.
+ Add setting to enable/disable dialogue box.
+ Each sister now have dialogue box with their own color.
+ Now you can interact with overlapping characters without the need to drag one out.
+ Spawned sisters and their position will be saved and loaded for the next sessions.

[b]- Bug fixes:[/b]
+ Fix a bug where you can drag your sister and Setting button outside of the screen.
+ Fix a bug where Character Hub window isn't updated when Rest button is clicked.
+ Dialogue Box will now follow sister more closely (when sister's size is changed).

Once again, thank you for your support! And please look forward to our next update in the future!

Love you forever!

Your Sisters.

notes.title: 🎉 Your Sisters is now available on Steam!
notes.content:
🎉 Welcome to the world of Your Sisters - where your desktop is no longer boring!
You turn on your PC. Everything looks the same: mouse, keyboard, deadlines.
 But today… something feels different.
A little girl with sparkling eyes is standing in the corner, watching you.


A knight in armor is looking closely at your mouse.


A grumpy cat is dancing like it wants to say: “Look at me!”


Yes! Your Sisters is now officially available on Steam!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45575888/62eafc6a660fda030f4507184ce528a16cf966fb.png[/img]
This is a light, cute, and fun desktop game where you can bring a whole squad of virtual girls to your screen. They stay with you all day, make you smile, and do funny things when you least expect it.
💡 Why do players love Your Sisters?
✅ Bring many characters to your screen at the same time, anime style, different personalities
 ✅ Interact directly - drag, drop, rotate, change outfits, chat, collect “Love Points” to unlock new stuff
 ✅ Deep customization - Resize, Freehand, Interactive, Automatic display modes
 ✅ Collect them all - 10 trading cards, 6 badges, and lots of special animations
 ✅ It’s not just a game - it’s a chill, cozy, healing space that gives you a little smile every time you open your PC
🧠 Who is Your Sisters for?
Office workers who need a cute companion to make their desktop fun


Casual players who love soft, interactive games


Fans of simple things like dragging cute stuff around the screen 😄

🎁 Download Your Sisters now on Steam - and let your desktop be more than just a work space. Let it be a happy space.
📌 Don’t forget to wishlist and leave us a review if you love our little sister crew!
 📸 Share your desktop with the tag #YourSistersGame - we’ll be watching 👀!
